source.all_rows_file_scope: TRANSCRIBED_ROWS.tsv is a normalized manual transcription of all 100 rows in original order, not a verbatim copy. Rows are parsed from it into this JSON.
source.timezone_policy: No UTC conversion; portal display timezone was not stated. Filename date tokens are not used to correct displayed dates.
